source_memory_room.name: Context And Source Memory

agents.claim: Use derived patterns and source IDs only.
Prioritize public identity mirror and concrete couple receipts.
Avoid repeating cooled-down lanes as fresh ideas.

source_memory_room.summary: Source memory loaded before concept selection, including the successful-carousel standard and creator preference ledger.
debate_records: Source Curator: treat photos, objects, outfits, and canon cards as evidence, never as the premise.
Successful Carousel Standard Reader: define success before writing as cold-viewer recognition, not beautiful art.
Creator Preference Ledger Reader: avoid stale perfect-husband, aesthetic-first, and repeated chaos/home lanes.

selected_outputs.what_success_looks_like: A cold viewer thinks 'this is us' or sends/saves/tags a partner because the relationship truth is recognizable before the art is admired.
selected_outputs.memory_policy: fresh route must not recycle cooled-down lanes as fresh ideas

story_meaning_room.name: Story Meaning Room

agents.claim: The route needs obstacle, proof, reversal, and earned payoff.
The meaning must be drawable through behavior.
Aachu gets spark; Zuv gets active response.
No obstacle means no story engine.

story_meaning_room.summary: Generated 5 story routes and selected Proof Before Poetry as the strongest raw meaning.
inputs_used:
I was never unsure of you. I was lost inside our life.
Choosing each other had answered the easiest question.
Then life began asking harder ones.
Some days, love did not tell us what to do.
Being lost together did not mean I had chosen wrong.
Commitment answered who. We are still learning how.
use process cards as influences, not the answer

audience_algorithm_room.name: Audience And Algorithm Room

agents.claim: The route must create curiosity and middle-slide re-engagement.
The route needs a send/save/tag reason.
Public copy should stay name-free and behavior-led.
The humor should feel warm, desi, and non-shaming.

audience_algorithm_room.summary: Audience pass checked reader mirror, send/save logic, and taste.
debate_records: Reader mirror: Readers enter through a concrete couple behavior they recognize.
Send/save reason: Saveable when it gives viewers language for a familiar relationship pattern.
Success pressure: a strong route must earn partner tags, saves, or DMs because the viewer is saying 'this is us', not because the art is pretty.
Swipe pressure: the middle must carry receipt density and at least one visual proof beat that can be understood before reading a caption.

contrarian_repair_room.name: Contrarian Repair Room

agents.claim: The winner must survive genericness and private-context objections.
Specific proof beats beat abstract romance.
No shaming, privacy leak, or copied expression.
The concept must become simple scenes.

contrarian_repair_room.summary: Top routes were attacked and repair needs were recorded.
debate_records: Attack 'Proof Before Poetry': hard_fails=['stage-scene gate has no drawable action/reaction proof', 'stage-scene gate has no visible active partner action']; repair target is stronger human obstacle, share setup, and visible Zuv action.
Attack 'Public Scene, Private Meaning': hard_fails=['stage-scene gate has no drawable action/reaction proof']; repair target is stronger human obstacle, share setup, and visible Zuv action.

Attack 'Anti-Ideal To Real Love': hard_fails=['stage-scene gate has no drawable action/reaction proof', 'stage-scene gate has no visible active partner action']; repair target is stronger human obstacle, share setup, and visible Zuv action.
Genericness Detector: reject routes that would get 'beautiful' but not 'this is us'.
Visual Generativity Skeptic: block any route that can only be expressed as poster copy.

agents.claim: The idea must play as action before copy.
Hands, distance, and object movement must prove the turn.
A viewer should understand the beat with text hidden.

exploration_routes.name: The House Became an Ocean
exploration_routes.story_lens: One domestic object changes function through a causal moonwater sequence, making mutual choice, conflicting method and resynchronization physical.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: The private recognition of being certain about a partner while the shared life still feels unfamiliar.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: Equal commitment does not automatically make two people's instincts, timing, or methods align.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu carries expressive equal agency without being framed as the problem.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv carries equal self-owned agency without becoming a handler or rescuer.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: dry shared table -> rising moonwater -> opposite strokes and circular wake -> reciprocal laugh plus oar realignment -> synchronized exit stroke
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: The visible circle stops reading as a verdict on the relationship once both people recognize it and change their method together.
exploration_routes.payoff: The horizon stays unfinished; commitment is proven by equal experimentation with the same person.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Sendable to the person you remain sure about while both of you are still learning how to live the shared life.

stage_scene_gate.action: They carry one table into a dry home, stabilize it as moonwater rises, row with opposite strokes until the raft circles, rotate their oars toward alignment, then make synchronized strokes out through the old wake.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Their attention moves from mutual certainty, to divided practical focus, to shared bafflement, to reciprocal laughter, to coordinated experimentation.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Eye-lines meet over the table, split toward separate demands, converge on the circular wake, reconnect at the turn, and finally alternate between each other and the unfinished horizon.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: The table changes from shared furniture to stable work surface to raft; separately owned oars move from opposed strokes, through visible realignment, into synchronized backward strokes on opposite outer sides.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The widening circular wake and resting moment before the oars realign create the quiet recognition beat.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: Opposed effort produces rotation; reciprocal recognition produces an observable change in method rather than a falsely solved destination.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: Being lost stops reading as evidence of a wrong partner and becomes the condition in which both people keep learning one next maneuver.

human_story_setup.visible_human_proof: They carry one table together, save different things around it, turn it into a raft, row with equal but opposed effort, laugh at the circle they made, realign their oars, and try one synchronized stroke.
human_story_setup.active_partner_role: Neither person rescues or manages the other. Each owns a task, an oar, the failed method, the repair, and the next experiment.
human_story_setup.emotional_turn: The visible circle stops reading as a verdict on the relationship once both people recognize it and change their method together.
human_story_setup.shareable_setup: Sendable to the person you remain sure about while both of you are still learning how to live the shared life.
human_story_setup.earned_payoff: The horizon stays unfinished; commitment is proven by equal experimentation with the same person.

success_definition.audience_success: A cold viewer thinks 'this is us' or sends/saves/tags a partner because the relationship truth is recognizable before the art is admired.
success_definition.creative_success: The deck works as silent panels: public hook, emotional obstacle, concrete receipts, active Zuv behavior, reversal, and earned final thesis.
success_definition.brand_success: The idea strengthens @a.storyof.two as warm, funny, desi relationship IP where small behaviors become evidence of love.
success_definition.production_success: Story-Selling and Golden Theme gates pass before C-layer writing, then visual, identity, request-locked native-format, QA, and audit gates must also pass. Default post/carousel delivery is 1080x1440 only; 1080x1920 Reel/Story is required only when explicitly requested.

stage_scene_gate.action: They carry one table into a dry home, stabilize it as moonwater rises, row with opposite strokes until the raft circles, rotate their oars toward alignment, then make synchronized strokes out through the old wake.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Their attention moves from mutual certainty, to divided practical focus, to shared bafflement, to reciprocal laughter, to coordinated experimentation.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Eye-lines meet over the table, split toward separate demands, converge on the circular wake, reconnect at the turn, and finally alternate between each other and the unfinished horizon.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: The table changes from shared furniture to stable work surface to raft; separately owned oars move from opposed strokes, through visible realignment, into synchronized backward strokes on opposite outer sides.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The widening circular wake and resting moment before the oars realign create the quiet recognition beat.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: Opposed effort produces rotation; reciprocal recognition produces an observable change in method rather than a falsely solved destination.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: Being lost stops reading as evidence of a wrong partner and becomes the condition in which both people keep learning one next maneuver.
